issues.summary: Equality guard still suppresses a real maximum dated exactly 1899-12-30 (undecidable from the sentinel given single cross-column MAX); in-code comment overstated 'targets only' sentinels.
issues.resolution: Accepted-by-design false-negative (1899-12-30 is the Access zero/default, effectively never a real max; true fix needs per-column provenance = DW-16). Rewrote comment to list two accepted false-negatives; folded both into DW-16; documented the accepted behaviour on the exact-epoch test.
